hlh/t0a0_start.name: Hazard Course: Welcome
hlh/t0a0_start.description: A grey training hall. A holographic projection of a balding scientist welcomes you to the Hazardous Environment Course and explains that he will teach you the HEV suit's basic functions.

hlh/t0a0a_moving.name: Hazard Course: Movement
hlh/t0a0a_moving.description: Ramps, crates and a low duct to crawl through, each with a hologram demonstrating how.

hlh/t0a0b_jumps.name: Hazard Course: Jumping and Ladders
hlh/t0a0b_jumps.description: Platforms over a padded pit, a ladder up a wall, and a long jump you'll make on the third try.

hlh/t0a0b1_water.name: Hazard Course: Swimming
hlh/t0a0b1_water.description: A deep pool with a submerged tunnel and a timer: hold your breath and swim.

hlh/t0a0c_charge.name: Hazard Course: Health and Suit
hlh/t0a0c_charge.description: A room with a health charger, an HEV charger and a battery on a stand, and a hologram explaining all three.

hlh/t0a0d_range.name: Hazard Course: Firing Range
hlh/t0a0d_range.description: A shooting range with paper targets and a rack of training weapons. At the end, a hologram congratulates you on completing the course.
